relevance: Closest discovered compiler-correctness case study for control flow to asynchronous dataflow/CIRCT.
capability: Lean core sequential→dataflow forward simulation and strong normalization theorem; Rust DSL front end, CIRCT Handshake/CGRA backends.
limitations: Theorems require affine-use, valid/confluent/frame-preserving operators and deterministic/nonblocking interpretation. Inspected core proof does not itself certify Rust parsing or CIRCT backend. cargo build does not check Lean proofs; requires lake build Thm.

relevance: Word RTL, memories and bit-level lowering useful for a proof-producing final RTL stage.
capability: Executable word RTL; source→DAG correctness; proved SV/RTLIL/AIGER parser roundtrips; validated ABC optimization; FIFO, RAM, CPU refinement examples.
limitations: Formal meaning of output is its own parser, cross-checked by Yosys/Icarus rather than a standard SV theorem. Exact runtime bytes not kernel-checked. Multiclock top decoded from comments plus exact reprint; no sequential optimization or existing PyTorch/MLIR importer.

relevance: Generic Design→µVerilog cycle preservation and selected exact-byte releases offer lower-level proof architecture.
capability: Typed synchronous/multiclock hardware, memories/channels; compile_cycle theorem; release invariant transport; RTL import through Yosys normalization.
limitations: Formal release ends at own two-state µVerilog semantics and bytes; real Verilog interpretation needs extra adequacy premise. No synthesis/netlist theorem; arbitrary hierarchy separate compilation unfinished. Snapshot STATUS notes partial CI recheck.

relevance: Same Loom README and advertised hardware stack as deepai-org/loom.
capability: Typed Design, certified execution, Verilog and multiclock channels, as documented.
limitations: Treat as related repository, not an independent verification framework; only its README inspected. Use loom source audit for semantic boundary, not as proof that histories are identical.

relevance: Reusable stuttering/internal-step refinement particularly relevant to scheduling and dataflow lowering.
capability: Flush-based simulation/trace inclusion theory; source-inspected join-join reassociation refinement; Bluespec allocator case study documented.
limitations: Abstract event/LTS model; no Calyx/Torch/MemRef parser or general RTL compiler theorem. Must establish confluence, commutation and flush relation for each pass.

relevance: Existing SSA/MLIR rewrite infrastructure plus experimental CIRCT closest to current compiler IR.
capability: Core denotation-preserving peephole rewriting; BitVec/LLVM proofs; experimental Comb, Handshake/DC and SCF.
limitations: CIRCT experiments are outside polished core. Inspected Comb semantics folds AND from zero and computes parity as LSB, so hardware semantics require independent review. Tree has no Calyx/MemRef/Linalg/Torch paths; absence is tree/name inspection, not comprehensive semantic proof.

relevance: Mutable MLIR IR, verification and proved compiler passes can host missing pipeline semantics.
capability: HW/Comb/Seq opcodes, attribute/width/effect checks; mature non-hardware interpreter/refinement/pass infrastructure.
limitations: Inspected Comb interpretOp' handles only add, all other opcodes none, and HasOpInfo instance does not register it. Seq file registers verifier/effects, not sequential execution. No Calyx/MemRef/Linalg/Torch paths in tree. IR well-formedness is not equivalence.

relevance: Lean HDL with SV/Yosys flow and concrete quantized BitNet accelerator examples.
capability: Signal DSL; bitvector equivalence and bounded latency checks; simulation/JIT; BitNet/CPU/IP catalog.
limitations: BitNet status distinguishes bounded small-width properties, golden testing and unfinished inference integration; its prose transitivity across golden tests is not a universal equivalence proof. Prior audit found admitted BitNet obligations; fresh pass reviewed status documentation, not rebuilt whole repository.

relevance: Rich circuit semantics, reflection and concrete arithmetic/sequential refinement examples.

relevance: Strong numerical refinement pattern for quantized datapath vs mathematical specification.
capability: Streaming fixed-point FFT→Mathlib DFT error bounds with range/no-overflow conditions; structural circuits and FIRRTL generation.
